# Design

How this app is built: its stack, layout and conventions.
Read it with `AGENTS.md`, which has the working rules and how the app is tested.

*TanStack's own documentation is vendored in this repo under `docs/tanstack/`: the official
`llms.txt` index for TanStack Router (`router.llms.txt`) and TanStack Query (`query.llms.txt`).
Consult it when working with TanStack Router or Query.*

---

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints — routes MUST live under `rest/api/`

Put every domain REST route under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/api/` so its path starts
with `/api/`: `SpaConfig` only lets `/api/*` reach the backend, and a non-`/api/` route is swallowed
by the SPA deep-link fallback (it returns `index.html`, not your endpoint). The reference below uses
non-`/api/` example paths for brevity — in this app the `/api/` prefix is required. See
`src/main/resources/officefloor/README.md`.

---

*The following is OfficeFloor's own agent guidance for this stack, included verbatim
from <https://officefloor.net/AGENTS.md>. It is part of the OfficeFloor architecture.*

## OfficeFloor REST endpoints

Applies when adding or changing REST endpoints. This project serves REST through
OfficeFloor Function Injection, **not** Spring MVC controllers: each endpoint is a
pipeline of small function classes wired together in YAML.

- Requires the OfficeFloor Spring Boot starter in the build:
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-4-starter` (Spring Boot 4.x) or
  `officefloor-rest-spring-boot-3-starter` (Spring Boot 3.x). Without it these YAML
  files are inert. (Rules below track these starter versions.)
- Define each endpoint as a YAML file under `src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/`,
  named `<path>.<METHOD>.yml` (e.g. `owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml` → `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`).
- One small function class per step; compose steps with `next:` and `outputs:`.
- Do NOT generate `@RestController`, `@GetMapping` or `@PostMapping`.
- Transactions: `govern: [ transaction ]` on steps, not `@Transactional`.
- Errors: a handler YAML in `officefloor/escalation/`, not `@ControllerAdvice`.

### Worked example — `PUT /owners/{ownerId}`

The whole shape of an endpoint. The sections after this one are the reference.

`src/main/resources/officefloor/rest/owners/{ownerId}.PUT.yml`

```yaml
# First step runs first. Validate before Load so an invalid body is a 400,
# not masked by a 404 for a missing owner.
validate:
  class: com.example.owner.ValidateOwner
  next: load
load:
  class: com.example.owner.LoadOwner
  next: apply
apply:
  class: com.example.owner.ApplyOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save
save:
  class: com.example.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond
respond:
  class: com.example.owner.RespondWithOwner
```

```java
// One public method each. State moves by Out<T> (set) → @Val (read), matched by type.
public class ValidateOwner {
  public void validate(@RequestBody @Valid OwnerRequest request, Out<OwnerRequest> body) {
    body.set(request); // body read once here; republished for later steps
  }
}
public class LoadOwner {
  public void load(@PathVariable("ownerId") int ownerId, OwnerRepository repository,
      Out<Owner> ownerOut) throws OwnerNotFoundException {
    Owner owner = repository.findById(ownerId);
    if (owner == null) throw new OwnerNotFoundException(ownerId); // handled below
    ownerOut.set(owner);
  }
}
public class ApplyOwner { // @Val yields the stored object, not a copy — mutate in place
  public void apply(@Val OwnerRequest request, @Val Owner owner) {
    owner.setFirstName(request.firstName());
    owner.setLastName(request.lastName());
  }
}
public class SaveOwner {
  public void save(@Val Owner owner, OwnerRepository repository) {
    repository.save(owner);
  }
}
public class RespondWithOwner {
  public void respond(@Val Owner owner, ObjectResponse<OwnerResponse> response) {
    response.send(OwnerResponse.from(owner)); // this step responds; 200 by default
  }
}
```

`src/main/resources/officefloor/escalation/com.example.owner.OwnerNotFoundException.yml`

```yaml
handle:
  class: com.example.owner.HandleOwnerNotFound
```

```java
public class HandleOwnerNotFound {
  public void handle(@Parameter OwnerNotFoundException ex,
      ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<String>> response) {
    response.send(new ResponseEntity<>(ex.getMessage(), HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND));
  }
}
```

### Step wiring

Each top-level YAML entry is a developer-chosen step name; the first is the entry
point. `class:` names the function. **Give each function class exactly one public
method** — several public methods fail at start-up unless every reference adds
`method:`.

- `next: <step>` — run that step afterwards. This step's return value arrives there
  as `@Parameter T`.
- `outputs: { <name>: <step> }` — conditional branches. Declare a
  `@FunctionalInterface` parameter annotated `@Flow("<name>")` and call it to take the
  branch; not calling it short-circuits.

### Function parameters

Declare only what the step needs; they resolve by role:

- `@PathVariable`, `@RequestParam`, `@RequestBody` — Spring MVC annotations work.
- Spring beans (repositories, mappers, services) — injected by type as normal.
- `ObjectResponse<T>` (`net.officefloor.web.ObjectResponse`) — send the response with
  `response.send(dto)`. This is how a step responds; wrap as
  `ObjectResponse<ResponseEntity<T>>` to set status explicitly.
- `@Parameter T` (`net.officefloor.plugin.section.clazz.Parameter`) — the previous
  step's return value, a `@Flow` argument, or a thrown escalation.

### Passing state between steps — `Out<T>` / `@Val`

Steps do not call each other. Beyond the single `@Parameter` hand-off, publish state
into a variable (`net.officefloor.plugin.variable`):

- Producer declares `Out<T>` and calls `set(...)`; consumer declares `@Val T`.
- Matching is **by type** — two variables of the same type in one pipeline need a
  `@Qualifier` annotation to disambiguate.
- `@Val` yields the same object the producer stored, **not a copy** — so an `Apply`
  step mutates the entity in place and later steps see the change.

### Naming

Verb plus entity: `Load<E>` (fetch by path variable, publishes `Out<E>`, throws when
absent) · `Build<E>` (construct from body) · `Validate<E>` (bind and validate the body,
publish it) · `Apply<E>` (mutate) · `Save<E>` · `Delete<E>` · `RespondWith<E>` (200) ·
`RespondWith<E>Created` (201) · `RespondWithNoContent` (204).

Keep DTOs at the edges — request body in at the first step, response DTO out at the
responder. Steps in between work with entities.

### Request body and validation

- The HTTP body can be read only once: **only one step per pipeline may bind
  `@RequestBody`**. A second binding fails at runtime. When later steps need it, the
  first step publishes it as a variable.
- `@Valid` runs before that step's method body, so step order decides when validation
  happens. Put the validating step first — otherwise a missing id returns 404 before an
  invalid body can return 400.

### Transactions

`govern: [ transaction ]` for writes, `govern: [ readonly-transaction ]` for reads,
listed on **every** step it covers. Both are provided by the starter. Governance spans
the pipeline, so the request commits once at the end.

### Errors

Functions throw; handlers respond. The exception must be **checked** (`extends
Exception`) so it appears in the `throws` clause. Put the handler in
`officefloor/escalation/<fully.qualified.ExceptionClass>.yml`, taking the exception as
`@Parameter` and responding via `ObjectResponse`. Matching is most-specific-first;
anything unmatched falls through to Spring `@RestControllerAdvice`.

### Security

Guard a whole endpoint file with a Spring Security SpEL expression:

```yaml
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"
```

# OfficeHQ

A full-stack office-management web application.

- **Front end:** React single-page app (TypeScript) with TanStack Router (file-based routes) and
  TanStack Query, built into `src/main/resources/static`.
- **Back end:** Spring Boot host with OfficeFloor REST endpoints, on an in-memory H2 database with
  Flyway migrations run on boot.

## Build and run

```
bin/build              # build the SPA and package one runnable jar
PORT=3000 bin/start    # start the app (serves the SPA + REST on $PORT)
bin/stop               # stop it
```

Readiness: `GET /actuator/health`.

## Tests

End-to-end tests use Playwright (in `e2e/`) and bind to `data-testid`:

```
bin/e2e                # build, start, run the specs in e2e/specs, then stop
```

package net.officefloor.hq.app.claim;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * A claim a person has on a sheet. {@code id} is null until the claim is first saved; {@code number}
 * is null unless the claim has been opened (a draft has none; a voided claim keeps it). {@code due} is the
 * due fixed when the claim was settled, or null while it is live (not settled, or settled with no rate).
 * {@code openedBy} is the user who opened the claim, or null while it is a draft. {@code stated} is whether
 * its person's last statement bound it to a figure, {@code statedDue} (null: n/a) — it then shows and totals
 * that figure, not its live one. {@code number} is sheet-wide (1, 2, ...) or, under period numbering,
 * within its period (P1-1, X-1). {@code corrects} is, for a correction, the number of the claim it corrects (null:
 * not a correction). {@code dueBy} is fixed when the claim is created: its date plus the terms of its person's
 * grade in force on that date; it does not change when the terms or its date change later. While PENDING the claim is not bound: it shows and totals its live figure, and is bound again
 * once rejected (back to OPEN) when the statement included it.
 */
public record Claim(Long id, String sheetId, long personId, BigDecimal amount, LocalDate date, String note,
        ClaimStatus status, String number, BigDecimal due, String openedBy, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue,
        String corrects, LocalDate dueBy) {

    /** The same claim with another status, number, fixed due and opener. */
    public Claim withStatus(ClaimStatus next, String nextNumber, BigDecimal nextDue, String nextOpenedBy) {
        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, next, nextNumber, nextDue, nextOpenedBy, stated,
                statedDue, corrects, dueBy);
    }

    /** The same claim as an open claim bound by no statement: live, with no fixed due. */
    public Claim asOpenUnbound() {
        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, ClaimStatus.OPEN, number, null, openedBy, false,
                null, corrects, dueBy);
    }

    /** Whether the claim is a correction: a negative amount naming the settled claim it corrects. */
    public boolean correction() {
        return corrects != null;
    }

    /** Whether the claim counts toward the totals: only OPEN, PENDING and SETTLED claims do. */
    public boolean counts() {
        return status.open() || status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
    }

    /** Whether the claim counts toward the live totals when a hold on its person covers it or not: a held open (or pending) claim does not. */
    public boolean counts(boolean held) {
        return status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED || (status.open() && !held);
    }

    /** Whether the claim is overdue on the given today: OPEN (or PENDING) with its due-by before that day. */
    public boolean overdue(LocalDate today) {
        return status.open() && dueBy != null && today != null && dueBy.isBefore(today);
    }

    /** Whether a statement binds the claim now: it was stated and is not PENDING. */
    public boolean bound() {
        return stated && status != ClaimStatus.PENDING;
    }

    /** Whether the claim keeps a figure whatever the rates: fixed when settled, or bound by a statement. */
    public boolean keepsFigure() {
        return due != null || (bound() && statedDue != null);
    }

    /**
     * The claim's figure (null: n/a): the due fixed when it was settled, else the figure its statement bound
     * it to (not while PENDING), else its amount at the given live rate (null: none), at least the sheet's floor — a correction has
     * no floor. Its live figure rounds by the sheet's policy date.
     */
    public BigDecimal figure(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, Rounding rounding) {
        if (due != null) {
            return due;
        }
        if (bound()) {
            return statedDue;
        }
        RoundingMode mode = rounding.modeFor(this);
        return correction() ? due(amount, liveRate, mode) : due(amount, liveRate, floor, mode);
    }

    /**
     * The claim's due (null: n/a): its {@link #figure figure}, plus the late charge on it while it is overdue. A
     * settled claim's fixed due already has the charge frozen in.
     */
    public BigDecimal due(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, LateCharge late, Rounding rounding) {
        BigDecimal figure = figure(liveRate, floor, rounding);
        return due != null || figure == null ? figure : figure.add(late.on(this, figure, rounding.modeFor(this)));
    }

    /** An amount times a percent rate, divided by 100, rounded by the mode to two decimals; null with no rate. */
    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, RoundingMode mode) {
        return rate == null ? null : amount.multiply(rate).movePointLeft(2).setScale(2, mode);
    }

    /** A live due: {@link #due(BigDecimal, BigDecimal, RoundingMode)}, raised to the floor; null with no rate. */
    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, BigDecimal floor, RoundingMode mode) {
        BigDecimal due = due(amount, rate, mode);
        return due == null || due.compareTo(floor) >= 0 ? due : floor.setScale(2);
    }

    /** The audit field for the claim's number, " number=<n>", or "" when it has none. */
    public static String auditNumber(String number) {
        return number == null ? "" : " number=" + number;
    }
}

import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

@Repository
public class ClaimRepository {

    private static final String COLUMNS = "id, sheet_id, person_id, amount, claim_date, note, status, claim_number, due, opened_by, stated, stated_due, corrects, due_by";

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public ClaimRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    /** The sheet's claims, newest first. */
    public List<Claim> findAll(String sheetId) {
        return jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? ORDER BY listed DESC, id DESC",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId);
    }

    /** The claim with this id on this sheet, or null. */
    public Claim find(String sheetId, long id) {
        List<Claim> found = jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? AND id = ?",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId, id);
        return found.isEmpty() ? null : found.get(0);
    }

    /** Insert a new claim (null id) or update an existing one; the claim as stored. */
    public Claim save(Claim claim) {
        if (claim.id() != null) {
            jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET amount = ?, claim_date = ?, note = ?, status = ?, claim_number = ?, due = ?, opened_by = ?, corrects = ? WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                    claim.amount(), Date.valueOf(claim.date()), claim.note(), claim.status().name(), claim.number(),
                    claim.due(), claim.openedBy(), claim.corrects(), claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
            return claim;
        }
        GeneratedKeyHolder keys = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
        jdbc.update(con -> {
            PreparedStatement ps = con.prepareStatement(
                    "INSERT INTO claim (sheet_id, person_id, amount, claim_date, note, status, corrects, due_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    new String[] { "id" });
            ps.setString(1, claim.sheetId());
            ps.setLong(2, claim.personId());
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, claim.amount());
            ps.setDate(4, Date.valueOf(claim.date()));
            ps.setString(5, claim.note());
            ps.setString(6, claim.status().name());
            ps.setString(7, claim.corrects());
            ps.setDate(8, Date.valueOf(claim.dueBy()));
            return ps;
        }, keys);
        return new Claim(keys.getKey().longValue(), claim.sheetId(), claim.personId(), claim.amount(), claim.date(),
                claim.note(), claim.status(), claim.number(), claim.due(), claim.openedBy(), false, null,
                claim.corrects(), claim.dueBy());
    }

    /** The person's claims, newest first. */
    public List<Claim> findForPerson(String sheetId, long personId) {
        return jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? AND person_id = ? ORDER BY listed DESC, id DESC",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId, personId);
    }

    /**
     * Move the claim to another person: it loses any figure a statement bound it to (live again) and is listed as
     * their newest claim; the claim as stored.
     */
    public Claim reassign(Claim claim, long personId) {
        jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET person_id = ?, stated = FALSE, stated_due = NULL,"
                + " listed = NEXT VALUE FOR claim_listed_seq WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                personId, claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
        return find(claim.sheetId(), claim.id());
    }

    /** Bind the claim to a statement's figure (null: n/a), or unbind it (live again) when not stated. */
    public void bindStatement(Claim claim, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue) {
        jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET stated = ?, stated_due = ? WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                stated, stated ? statedDue : null, claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
    }

    private static Claim map(ResultSet rs, int n) throws SQLException {
        return new Claim(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("sheet_id"), rs.getLong("person_id"),
                rs.getBigDecimal("amount").setScale(2), rs.getDate("claim_date").toLocalDate(), rs.getString("note"),
                ClaimStatus.valueOf(rs.getString("status")), rs.getString("claim_number"),
                rs.getBigDecimal("due"), rs.getString("opened_by"), rs.getBoolean("stated"), rs.getBigDecimal("stated_due"),
                rs.getString("corrects"), rs.getDate("due_by").toLocalDate());
    }
}

/**
 * A change of a claim's status: the status it may start from, the status it ends in, and its audit event. PEND is
 * never asked for by name: it is what a clerk's settle becomes when the due is above the clerk limit. RESETTLE
 * freezes a SETTLED claim again at today's figure.
 */
public enum ClaimAction {
    OPEN("open", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_OPENED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT),
    SETTLE("settle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_SETTLED", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
    PEND(null, ClaimStatus.PENDING, "CLAIM_PENDING", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
    APPROVE("approve", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_APPROVED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    REJECT("reject", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_REJECTED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    VOID("void", ClaimStatus.VOID, "CLAIM_VOIDED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT, ClaimStatus.OPEN, ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    RESETTLE("resettle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_RESETTLED", ClaimStatus.SETTLED);

    private final String path;
    private final ClaimStatus to;
    private final String event;
    private final ClaimStatus[] from;

    ClaimAction(String path, ClaimStatus to, String event, ClaimStatus... from) {
        this.path = path;
        this.to = to;
        this.event = event;
        this.from = from;
    }

    /** The action named in the path, or null. */
    public static ClaimAction of(String path) {
        for (ClaimAction action : values()) {
            if (action.path != null && action.path.equals(path)) {
                return action;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean allowedFrom(ClaimStatus status) {
        for (ClaimStatus s : from) {
            if (s == status) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public ClaimStatus to() {
        return to;
    }

    public String event() {
        return event;
    }

    /** Whether the action fixes the claim's due: settling, approving a pending settle, or re-settling. */
    public boolean settles() {
        return to == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
    }
}

277	import java.math.BigDecimal;
278	import java.math.RoundingMode;
279	import java.time.LocalDate;
280	
281	/**
282	 * A claim a person has on a sheet. {@code id} is null until the claim is first saved; {@code number}
283	 * is null unless the claim has been opened (a draft has none; a voided claim keeps it). {@code due} is the
284	 * due fixed when the claim was settled, or null while it is live (not settled, or settled with no rate).
285	 * {@code openedBy} is the user who opened the claim, or null while it is a draft. {@code stated} is whether
286	 * its person's last statement bound it to a figure, {@code statedDue} (null: n/a) — it then shows and totals
287	 * that figure, not its live one. {@code number} is sheet-wide (1, 2, ...) or, under period numbering,
288	 * within its period (P1-1, X-1). {@code corrects} is, for a correction, the number of the claim it corrects (null:
289	 * not a correction). {@code dueBy} is fixed when the claim is created: its date plus the terms of its person's
290	 * grade in force on that date; it does not change when the terms or its date change later. While PENDING the claim is not bound: it shows and totals its live figure, and is bound again
291	 * once rejected (back to OPEN) when the statement included it.
292	 */
293	public record Claim(Long id, String sheetId, long personId, BigDecimal amount, LocalDate date, String note,
294	        ClaimStatus status, String number, BigDecimal due, String openedBy, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue,
295	        String corrects, LocalDate dueBy) {
296	
297	    /** The same claim with another status, number, fixed due and opener. */
298	    public Claim withStatus(ClaimStatus next, String nextNumber, BigDecimal nextDue, String nextOpenedBy) {
299	        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, next, nextNumber, nextDue, nextOpenedBy, stated,
300	                statedDue, corrects, dueBy);
301	    }
302	
303	    /** The same claim as an open claim bound by no statement: live, with no fixed due. */
304	    public Claim asOpenUnbound() {
305	        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, ClaimStatus.OPEN, number, null, openedBy, false,
306	                null, corrects, dueBy);
307	    }
308	
309	    /** Whether the claim is a correction: a negative amount naming the settled claim it corrects. */
310	    public boolean correction() {
311	        return corrects != null;
312	    }
313	
314	    /** Whether the claim counts toward the totals: only OPEN, PENDING and SETTLED claims do. */
315	    public boolean counts() {
316	        return status.open() || status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
317	    }
318	
319	    /** Whether the claim counts toward the live totals when a hold on its person covers it or not: a held open (or pending) claim does not. */
320	    public boolean counts(boolean held) {
321	        return status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED || (status.open() && !held);
322	    }
323	
324	    /** Whether the claim is overdue on the given today: OPEN (or PENDING) with its due-by before that day. */
325	    public boolean overdue(LocalDate today) {
326	        return status.open() && dueBy != null && today != null && dueBy.isBefore(today);
327	    }
328	
329	    /** Whether a statement binds the claim now: it was stated and is not PENDING. */
330	    public boolean bound() {
331	        return stated && status != ClaimStatus.PENDING;
332	    }
333	
334	    /** Whether the claim keeps a figure whatever the rates: fixed when settled, or bound by a statement. */
335	    public boolean keepsFigure() {
336	        return due != null || (bound() && statedDue != null);
337	    }
338	
339	    /**
340	     * The claim's figure (null: n/a): the due fixed when it was settled, else the figure its statement bound
341	     * it to (not while PENDING), else its amount at the given live rate (null: none), at least the sheet's floor — a correction has
342	     * no floor. Its live figure rounds by the sheet's policy date.
343	     */
344	    public BigDecimal figure(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, Rounding rounding) {
345	        if (due != null) {
346	            return due;
347	        }
348	        if (bound()) {
349	            return statedDue;
350	        }
351	        RoundingMode mode = rounding.modeFor(this);
352	        return correction() ? due(amount, liveRate, mode) : due(amount, liveRate, floor, mode);
353	    }
354	
355	    /**
356	     * The claim's due (null: n/a): its {@link #figure figure}, plus the late charge on it while it is overdue. A
357	     * settled claim's fixed due already has the charge frozen in.
358	     */
359	    public BigDecimal due(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, LateCharge late, Rounding rounding) {
360	        BigDecimal figure = figure(liveRate, floor, rounding);
361	        return due != null || figure == null ? figure : figure.add(late.on(this, figure, rounding.modeFor(this)));
362	    }
363	
364	    /** An amount times a percent rate, divided by 100, rounded by the mode to two decimals; null with no rate. */
365	    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, RoundingMode mode) {
366	        return rate == null ? null : amount.multiply(rate).movePointLeft(2).setScale(2, mode);
367	    }
368	
369	    /** A live due: {@link #due(BigDecimal, BigDecimal, RoundingMode)}, raised to the floor; null with no rate. */
370	    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, BigDecimal floor, RoundingMode mode) {
371	        BigDecimal due = due(amount, rate, mode);
372	        return due == null || due.compareTo(floor) >= 0 ? due : floor.setScale(2);
373	    }
374	
375	    /** The audit field for the claim's number, " number=<n>", or "" when it has none. */
376	    public static String auditNumber(String number) {
377	        return number == null ? "" : " number=" + number;
378	    }
379	}

480	 * freezes a SETTLED claim again at today's figure.

482	public enum ClaimAction {
483	    OPEN("open", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_OPENED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT),
484	    SETTLE("settle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_SETTLED", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
485	    PEND(null, ClaimStatus.PENDING, "CLAIM_PENDING", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
486	    APPROVE("approve", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_APPROVED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
487	    REJECT("reject", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_REJECTED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
488	    VOID("void", ClaimStatus.VOID, "CLAIM_VOIDED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT, ClaimStatus.OPEN, ClaimStatus.PENDING),
489	    RESETTLE("resettle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_RESETTLED", ClaimStatus.SETTLED);
490	
491	    private final String path;
492	    private final ClaimStatus to;
493	    private final String event;
494	    private final ClaimStatus[] from;
495	
496	    ClaimAction(String path, ClaimStatus to, String event, ClaimStatus... from) {
497	        this.path = path;
498	        this.to = to;
499	        this.event = event;
500	        this.from = from;
501	    }

503	    /** The action named in the path, or null. */
504	    public static ClaimAction of(String path) {
505	        for (ClaimAction action : values()) {
506	            if (action.path != null && action.path.equals(path)) {
507	                return action;
508	            }
509	        }
510	        return null;
511	    }

513	    public boolean allowedFrom(ClaimStatus status) {
514	        for (ClaimStatus s : from) {
515	            if (s == status) {
516	                return true;
517	            }
518	        }
519	        return false;
520	    }

522	    public ClaimStatus to() {
523	        return to;
524	    }

527	        return event;
528	    }

551	/**
552	 * Moves the claim to the action's status; refused (400) when the claim's status does not allow it.
553	 * Opening gives the claim the sheet's next number; a voided claim keeps its number (it is never reused). While the
554	 * sheet's period numbering from date is set and its today is on or after it, opening instead gives the claim the next
555	 * number within the period containing its date (P1-1, P1-2, ...), or within the claims in no period (X-1, ...).
556	 * Opening records the user who opened it; that user cannot settle it (four eyes).
557	 * Settling fixes the claim's due at its person's grade's rate in force on the claim's date, raised to the sheet's floor and rounded by its policy date — or, when a statement
558	 * bound the claim, at the figure it was bound to — plus the late charge it has then, if overdue, frozen in; with no
559	 * figure it stays live. A clerk settling a claim whose due is above the sheet's clerk limit (a due of n/a is within any
560	 * limit) makes it PENDING instead, live and unfixed. Only a steward approves a PENDING claim (fixing its due at its live
561	 * figure, plus any late charge, at that moment) — not the user who opened it — or rejects it, with a reason, back to OPEN.
562	 * Only a steward re-settles a SETTLED claim, fixing its due again at the figure it would have today as an open claim
563	 * bound by no statement (today's rates, grades, floor and late charge); its previous due is kept for the audit.
564	 */
565	public class ApplyClaimAction {
566	    public void apply(@PathVariable("action") String action, @RequestParam("user") String user, @Val Claim claim,
567	            @Val ClaimActionRequest request, SheetRepository sheets,
568	            PersonRepository people, RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, PeriodRepository periods,
569	            ClaimRepository claims, Out<ClaimAction> applied, Out<ClaimNumber> number, Out<PreviousDue> previous, Out<Claim> updated) throws InvalidClaimException {
570	        ClaimAction found = ClaimAction.of(action);
571	        if (found == null) {
572	            throw new InvalidClaimException("No such claim action: " + action);
573	        }
574	        if (!found.allowedFrom(claim.status())) {
575	            throw new InvalidClaimException("A " + claim.status() + " claim cannot be " + found.to() + ".");
576	        }
577	        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
578	            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot settle it.");
579	        }
580	        if (found == ClaimAction.APPROVE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
581	            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot approve it.");
582	        }
583	        if ((found == ClaimAction.APPROVE || found == ClaimAction.REJECT)
584	                && settings.find(claim.sheetId()).roleOf(user) != Role.STEWARD) {
585	            throw new InvalidClaimException("Only a steward can " + action + " a pending claim.");
586	        }
587	        if (found == ClaimAction.RESETTLE && settings.find(claim.sheetId()).roleOf(user) != Role.STEWARD) {
588	            throw new InvalidClaimException("Only a steward can re-settle a settled claim.");
589	        }
590	        if (found == ClaimAction.REJECT && request.reason().isEmpty()) {
591	            throw new InvalidClaimException("A reason is required to reject a claim.");
592	        }
593	        BigDecimal due = found.settles() ? settledDue(found == ClaimAction.RESETTLE ? claim.asOpenUnbound() : claim, sheets, people, rates, settings, claims) : claim.due();
594	        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && !settings.find(claim.sheetId()).maySettle(user, due)) {
595	            found = ClaimAction.PEND;
596	            due = null;
597	        }
598	        String next = switch (found) {
599	            case OPEN -> nextNumber(claim, sheets, settings, periods);
600	            default -> claim.number();
601	        };
602	        applied.set(found);
603	        previous.set(new PreviousDue(claim.due()));
604	        number.set(new ClaimNumber(next));
605	        updated.set(claim.withStatus(found.to(), next, due, found == ClaimAction.OPEN ? user : claim.openedBy()));
606	    }
607	
608	    private static String nextNumber(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, SettingRepository settings,
609	            PeriodRepository periods) {
610	        LocalDate from = settings.periodNumberingFrom(claim.sheetId());
611	        if (from == null || sheets.today(claim.sheetId()).isBefore(from)) {
612	            return String.valueOf(sheets.nextClaimNumber(claim.sheetId()));
613	        }
614	        Period period = periods.findAll(claim.sheetId()).stream().filter((p) -> p.contains(claim.date())).findFirst()
615	                .orElse(null);
616	        String prefix = period == null ? "X" : period.name();
617	        String key = period == null ? "" : period.name().toLowerCase();
618	        return prefix + "-" + sheets.nextPeriodClaimNumber(claim.sheetId(), key);
619	    }
620	
621	    private static BigDecimal settledDue(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, PersonRepository people,
622	            RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, ClaimRepository claims) {
623	        return ClaimDueNow.of(claim, sheets, people, rates, settings, claims);
624	    }
625	}

package net.officefloor.hq.app.claim;

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.math.RoundingMode;
import java.time.LocalDate;

/**
 * A claim a person has on a sheet. {@code id} is null until the claim is first saved; {@code number}
 * is null unless the claim has been opened (a draft has none; a voided claim keeps it). {@code due} is the
 * due fixed when the claim was settled, or null while it is live (not settled, or settled with no rate).
 * {@code openedBy} is the user who opened the claim, or null while it is a draft. {@code stated} is whether
 * its person's last statement bound it to a figure, {@code statedDue} (null: n/a) — it then shows and totals
 * that figure, not its live one. {@code number} is sheet-wide (1, 2, ...) or, under period numbering,
 * within its period (P1-1, X-1). {@code corrects} is, for a correction, the number of the claim it corrects (null:
 * not a correction). {@code dueBy} is fixed when the claim is created: its date plus the terms of its person's
 * grade in force on that date; it does not change when the terms or its date change later. While PENDING the claim is not bound: it shows and totals its live figure, and is bound again
 * once rejected (back to OPEN) when the statement included it.
 */
public record Claim(Long id, String sheetId, long personId, BigDecimal amount, LocalDate date, String note,
        ClaimStatus status, String number, BigDecimal due, String openedBy, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue,
        String corrects, LocalDate dueBy) {

    /** The same claim with another status, number, fixed due and opener. */
    public Claim withStatus(ClaimStatus next, String nextNumber, BigDecimal nextDue, String nextOpenedBy) {
        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, next, nextNumber, nextDue, nextOpenedBy, stated,
                statedDue, corrects, dueBy);
    }

    /** The same claim as an open claim bound by no statement: live, with no fixed due. */
    public Claim asOpenUnbound() {
        return new Claim(id, sheetId, personId, amount, date, note, ClaimStatus.OPEN, number, null, openedBy, false,
                null, corrects, dueBy);
    }

    /** Whether the claim is a correction: a negative amount naming the settled claim it corrects. */
    public boolean correction() {
        return corrects != null;
    }

    /** Whether the claim counts toward the totals: only OPEN, PENDING and SETTLED claims do. */
    public boolean counts() {
        return status.open() || status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
    }

    /** Whether the claim counts toward the live totals when a hold on its person covers it or not: a held open (or pending) claim does not. */
    public boolean counts(boolean held) {
        return status == ClaimStatus.SETTLED || (status.open() && !held);
    }

    /** Whether the claim is overdue on the given today: OPEN (or PENDING) with its due-by before that day. */
    public boolean overdue(LocalDate today) {
        return status.open() && dueBy != null && today != null && dueBy.isBefore(today);
    }

    /** Whether a statement binds the claim now: it was stated and is not PENDING. */
    public boolean bound() {
        return stated && status != ClaimStatus.PENDING;
    }

    /** Whether the claim keeps a figure whatever the rates: fixed when settled, or bound by a statement. */
    public boolean keepsFigure() {
        return due != null || (bound() && statedDue != null);
    }

    /**
     * The claim's figure (null: n/a): the due fixed when it was settled, else the figure its statement bound
     * it to (not while PENDING), else its amount at the given live rate (null: none), at least the sheet's floor — a correction has
     * no floor. Its live figure rounds by the sheet's policy date.
     */
    public BigDecimal figure(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, Rounding rounding) {
        if (due != null) {
            return due;
        }
        if (bound()) {
            return statedDue;
        }
        RoundingMode mode = rounding.modeFor(this);
        return correction() ? due(amount, liveRate, mode) : due(amount, liveRate, floor, mode);
    }

    /**
     * The claim's due (null: n/a): its {@link #figure figure}, plus the late charge on it while it is overdue. A
     * settled claim's fixed due already has the charge frozen in.
     */
    public BigDecimal due(BigDecimal liveRate, BigDecimal floor, LateCharge late, Rounding rounding) {
        BigDecimal figure = figure(liveRate, floor, rounding);
        return due != null || figure == null ? figure : figure.add(late.on(this, figure, rounding.modeFor(this)));
    }

    /** An amount times a percent rate, divided by 100, rounded by the mode to two decimals; null with no rate. */
    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, RoundingMode mode) {
        return rate == null ? null : amount.multiply(rate).movePointLeft(2).setScale(2, mode);
    }

    /** A live due: {@link #due(BigDecimal, BigDecimal, RoundingMode)}, raised to the floor; null with no rate. */
    public static BigDecimal due(BigDecimal amount, BigDecimal rate, BigDecimal floor, RoundingMode mode) {
        BigDecimal due = due(amount, rate, mode);
        return due == null || due.compareTo(floor) >= 0 ? due : floor.setScale(2);
    }

    /** The audit field for the claim's number, " number=<n>", or "" when it has none. */
    public static String auditNumber(String number) {
        return number == null ? "" : " number=" + number;
    }
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.sql.Date;
import java.sql.PreparedStatement;
import java.sql.ResultSet;
import java.sql.SQLException;
import java.util.List;
import org.springframework.jdbc.core.JdbcTemplate;
import org.springframework.jdbc.support.GeneratedKeyHolder;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Repository;

@Repository
public class ClaimRepository {

    private static final String COLUMNS = "id, sheet_id, person_id, amount, claim_date, note, status, claim_number, due, opened_by, stated, stated_due, corrects, due_by";

    private final JdbcTemplate jdbc;

    public ClaimRepository(JdbcTemplate jdbc) {
        this.jdbc = jdbc;
    }

    /** The sheet's claims, newest first. */
    public List<Claim> findAll(String sheetId) {
        return jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? ORDER BY listed DESC, id DESC",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId);
    }

    /** The claim with this id on this sheet, or null. */
    public Claim find(String sheetId, long id) {
        List<Claim> found = jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? AND id = ?",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId, id);
        return found.isEmpty() ? null : found.get(0);
    }

    /** Insert a new claim (null id) or update an existing one; the claim as stored. */
    public Claim save(Claim claim) {
        if (claim.id() != null) {
            jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET amount = ?, claim_date = ?, note = ?, status = ?, claim_number = ?, due = ?, opened_by = ?, corrects = ? WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                    claim.amount(), Date.valueOf(claim.date()), claim.note(), claim.status().name(), claim.number(),
                    claim.due(), claim.openedBy(), claim.corrects(), claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
            return claim;
        }
        GeneratedKeyHolder keys = new GeneratedKeyHolder();
        jdbc.update(con -> {
            PreparedStatement ps = con.prepareStatement(
                    "INSERT INTO claim (sheet_id, person_id, amount, claim_date, note, status, corrects, due_by) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)",
                    new String[] { "id" });
            ps.setString(1, claim.sheetId());
            ps.setLong(2, claim.personId());
            ps.setBigDecimal(3, claim.amount());
            ps.setDate(4, Date.valueOf(claim.date()));
            ps.setString(5, claim.note());
            ps.setString(6, claim.status().name());
            ps.setString(7, claim.corrects());
            ps.setDate(8, Date.valueOf(claim.dueBy()));
            return ps;
        }, keys);
        return new Claim(keys.getKey().longValue(), claim.sheetId(), claim.personId(), claim.amount(), claim.date(),
                claim.note(), claim.status(), claim.number(), claim.due(), claim.openedBy(), false, null,
                claim.corrects(), claim.dueBy());
    }

    /** The person's claims, newest first. */
    public List<Claim> findForPerson(String sheetId, long personId) {
        return jdbc.query("SELECT " + COLUMNS + " FROM claim WHERE sheet_id = ? AND person_id = ? ORDER BY listed DESC, id DESC",
                ClaimRepository::map, sheetId, personId);
    }

    /**
     * Move the claim to another person: it loses any figure a statement bound it to (live again) and is listed as
     * their newest claim; the claim as stored.
     */
    public Claim reassign(Claim claim, long personId) {
        jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET person_id = ?, stated = FALSE, stated_due = NULL,"
                + " listed = NEXT VALUE FOR claim_listed_seq WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                personId, claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
        return find(claim.sheetId(), claim.id());
    }

    /** Bind the claim to a statement's figure (null: n/a), or unbind it (live again) when not stated. */
    public void bindStatement(Claim claim, boolean stated, BigDecimal statedDue) {
        jdbc.update("UPDATE claim SET stated = ?, stated_due = ? WHERE id = ? AND sheet_id = ?",
                stated, stated ? statedDue : null, claim.id(), claim.sheetId());
    }

    private static Claim map(ResultSet rs, int n) throws SQLException {
        return new Claim(rs.getLong("id"), rs.getString("sheet_id"), rs.getLong("person_id"),
                rs.getBigDecimal("amount").setScale(2), rs.getDate("claim_date").toLocalDate(), rs.getString("note"),
                ClaimStatus.valueOf(rs.getString("status")), rs.getString("claim_number"),
                rs.getBigDecimal("due"), rs.getString("opened_by"), rs.getBoolean("stated"), rs.getBigDecimal("stated_due"),
                rs.getString("corrects"), rs.getDate("due_by").toLocalDate());
    }
}

/**
 * A change of a claim's status: the status it may start from, the status it ends in, and its audit event. PEND is
 * never asked for by name: it is what a clerk's settle becomes when the due is above the clerk limit. RESETTLE
 * freezes a SETTLED claim again at today's figure.
 */
public enum ClaimAction {
    OPEN("open", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_OPENED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT),
    SETTLE("settle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_SETTLED", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
    PEND(null, ClaimStatus.PENDING, "CLAIM_PENDING", ClaimStatus.OPEN),
    APPROVE("approve", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_APPROVED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    REJECT("reject", ClaimStatus.OPEN, "CLAIM_REJECTED", ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    VOID("void", ClaimStatus.VOID, "CLAIM_VOIDED", ClaimStatus.DRAFT, ClaimStatus.OPEN, ClaimStatus.PENDING),
    RESETTLE("resettle", ClaimStatus.SETTLED, "CLAIM_RESETTLED", ClaimStatus.SETTLED);

    private final String path;
    private final ClaimStatus to;
    private final String event;
    private final ClaimStatus[] from;

    ClaimAction(String path, ClaimStatus to, String event, ClaimStatus... from) {
        this.path = path;
        this.to = to;
        this.event = event;
        this.from = from;
    }

    /** The action named in the path, or null. */
    public static ClaimAction of(String path) {
        for (ClaimAction action : values()) {
            if (action.path != null && action.path.equals(path)) {
                return action;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    public boolean allowedFrom(ClaimStatus status) {
        for (ClaimStatus s : from) {
            if (s == status) {
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    public ClaimStatus to() {
        return to;
    }

    public String event() {
        return event;
    }

    /** Whether the action fixes the claim's due: settling, approving a pending settle, or re-settling. */
    public boolean settles() {
        return to == ClaimStatus.SETTLED;
    }
}

import java.math.BigDecimal;
import java.time.LocalDate;
import net.officefloor.hq.app.period.Period;

import net.officefloor.hq.app.person.PersonRepository;

import net.officefloor.hq.app.sheet.SheetRepository;

import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RequestParam;

/**
 * Moves the claim to the action's status; refused (400) when the claim's status does not allow it.
 * Opening gives the claim the sheet's next number; a voided claim keeps its number (it is never reused). While the
 * sheet's period numbering from date is set and its today is on or after it, opening instead gives the claim the next
 * number within the period containing its date (P1-1, P1-2, ...), or within the claims in no period (X-1, ...).
 * Opening records the user who opened it; that user cannot settle it (four eyes).
 * Settling fixes the claim's due at its person's grade's rate in force on the claim's date, raised to the sheet's floor and rounded by its policy date — or, when a statement
 * bound the claim, at the figure it was bound to — plus the late charge it has then, if overdue, frozen in; with no
 * figure it stays live. A clerk settling a claim whose due is above the sheet's clerk limit (a due of n/a is within any
 * limit) makes it PENDING instead, live and unfixed. Only a steward approves a PENDING claim (fixing its due at its live
 * figure, plus any late charge, at that moment) — not the user who opened it — or rejects it, with a reason, back to OPEN.
 * Only a steward re-settles a SETTLED claim, fixing its due again at the figure it would have today as an open claim
 * bound by no statement (today's rates, grades, floor and late charge); its previous due is kept for the audit.
 */
public class ApplyClaimAction {
    public void apply(@PathVariable("action") String action, @RequestParam("user") String user, @Val Claim claim,
            @Val ClaimActionRequest request, SheetRepository sheets,
            PersonRepository people, RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, PeriodRepository periods,
            ClaimRepository claims, Out<ClaimAction> applied, Out<ClaimNumber> number, Out<PreviousDue> previous, Out<Claim> updated) throws InvalidClaimException {
        ClaimAction found = ClaimAction.of(action);
        if (found == null) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("No such claim action: " + action);
        }
        if (!found.allowedFrom(claim.status())) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("A " + claim.status() + " claim cannot be " + found.to() + ".");
        }
        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot settle it.");
        }
        if (found == ClaimAction.APPROVE && user.equals(claim.openedBy())) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("The user who opened a claim cannot approve it.");
        }
        if ((found == ClaimAction.APPROVE || found == ClaimAction.REJECT)
                && settings.find(claim.sheetId()).roleOf(user) != Role.STEWARD) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("Only a steward can " + action + " a pending claim.");
        }
        if (found == ClaimAction.RESETTLE && settings.find(claim.sheetId()).roleOf(user) != Role.STEWARD) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("Only a steward can re-settle a settled claim.");
        }
        if (found == ClaimAction.REJECT && request.reason().isEmpty()) {
            throw new InvalidClaimException("A reason is required to reject a claim.");
        }
        BigDecimal due = found.settles() ? settledDue(found == ClaimAction.RESETTLE ? claim.asOpenUnbound() : claim, sheets, people, rates, settings, claims) : claim.due();
        if (found == ClaimAction.SETTLE && !settings.find(claim.sheetId()).maySettle(user, due)) {
            found = ClaimAction.PEND;
            due = null;
        }
        String next = switch (found) {
            case OPEN -> nextNumber(claim, sheets, settings, periods);
            default -> claim.number();
        };
        applied.set(found);
        previous.set(new PreviousDue(claim.due()));
        number.set(new ClaimNumber(next));
        updated.set(claim.withStatus(found.to(), next, due, found == ClaimAction.OPEN ? user : claim.openedBy()));
    }

    private static String nextNumber(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, SettingRepository settings,
            PeriodRepository periods) {
        LocalDate from = settings.periodNumberingFrom(claim.sheetId());
        if (from == null || sheets.today(claim.sheetId()).isBefore(from)) {
            return String.valueOf(sheets.nextClaimNumber(claim.sheetId()));
        }
        Period period = periods.findAll(claim.sheetId()).stream().filter((p) -> p.contains(claim.date())).findFirst()
                .orElse(null);
        String prefix = period == null ? "X" : period.name();
        String key = period == null ? "" : period.name().toLowerCase();
        return prefix + "-" + sheets.nextPeriodClaimNumber(claim.sheetId(), key);
    }

    private static BigDecimal settledDue(Claim claim, SheetRepository sheets, PersonRepository people,
            RateRepository rates, SettingRepository settings, ClaimRepository claims) {
        return ClaimDueNow.of(claim, sheets, people, rates, settings, claims);
    }
}

/**
 * Records the claim's status change, with its person's name; runs only once the change has been allowed.
 * Settling and approving also record the due fixed (n/a when the grade had no rate); rejecting records its reason;
 * re-settling records the previous due and the new one.
 */
public class AuditClaimAction {
    public void audit(@Val ClaimAction action, @Val ClaimNumber number, @Val Claim claim, @Val ClaimActionRequest request,
            @Val PreviousDue previous,
            PersonRepository people,
            @RequestParam("user") String user, Audit audit) {
        Person person = people.find(claim.sheetId(), claim.personId());
        audit.record(action.event() + " sheet=" + claim.sheetId() + " by=" + user + " person="
                + (person == null ? "" : person.name()) + " amount=" + claim.amount().setScale(2).toPlainString()
                + " date=" + claim.date() + Claim.auditNumber(number.value())
                + (action == ClaimAction.RESETTLE
                        ? " old=" + figure(previous.value()) + " new=" + figure(claim.due())
                        : action.settles() ? " due=" + figure(claim.due()) : "")
                + (action == ClaimAction.REJECT ? " reason=" + request.reason() : ""));
    }

    private static String figure(BigDecimal due) {
        return due == null ? "n/a" : due.setScale(2).toPlainString();
    }
}

/**

 * grade's rate in force on its date, raised to the sheet's floor in force on its date and rounded by its policy date — or the figure a

public final class ClaimDueNow {
